subject: Meridian Labs — activation playbook, PO routing, DPA & subprocessor confirmations
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@meridianlabs.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@meridianlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:34 -0700
Subject: Meridian activation — DPA, processors list, and PO guidance

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the call this morning — excited to get Redwood turned up for our pilot. Procurement asked me to send the compliance artifacts they'd need to kick off a PO and activation. Attached are: Meridian_Compliance_Packet.zip (includes our SOC2 snapshot link and vendor questionnaire) and the current subprocessor registry.

Can you confirm the docs Redwood needs to set us active (PO number, signed DPA, invoice remittance instructions)? If you could also point us to the preferred PO template/format and an estimate for initial monthly committed spend, that would help get approvals through our finance team.

Short ask: what exact items do we need back from Meridian to close activation and issue the PO?

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Sr. IT Procurement
Meridian Labs
Attachment: Meridian_Compliance_Packet.zip (manifest: SOC2-report-link.txt, subprocessor-list.xlsx)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:05:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian activation — DPA, processors list, and PO guidance

Alex — great to meet earlier. Thanks for sending the packet. Quick checklist from our side so we can move to PO issuance and environment provisioning: 

1) Signed DPA (we accept DocuSign or PDF with authorized signature) — if you send via DocuSign we can auto-ingest.
2) Final subprocessor list in Excel (we need columns: name, role, hosting location, contact) — I see an initial spreadsheet but procurement needs a single-sheet canonical file.
3) PO details: legal entity name to be billed, billing address, and PO number (if Meridian requires Redwood to quote a PO number, confirm now).
4) Remit & invoice instructions (email + AP contact).
5) Confirmation of required term (monthly/annual) + expected first invoice amount (we can issue an estimate).

Im looping in Marcus (procurement ops) to outline the PO path and LAURA (legal) for DPA sign-off. If you prefer, Marcus can open the purchase request in our portal and send the Redwood PO template.

Next step: Alex, if you can send the signed DPA and the single-sheet subprocessor file today or tomorrow, we’ll start the PO and provisioning.

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_PO_Template.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 09:18:40 -07:00
Subject: RE: Meridian activation — DPA, processors list, and PO guidance

Hi Alex / Rachel — quick note on PO routing and timing: 

- If Meridian sends a signed DPA (DocuSign link or PDF), Legal will confirm countersignature within 24–48 hours.
- For the PO, we accept either: (A) Meridian's PO referencing Redwood's invoice (email invoices@redwood.com) or (B) we can raise an internal PO on your behalf if you provide the billing entity and PO number. Option B is faster for pilot setups.
- Please use the attached Redwood_PO_Template.pdf if you want Redwood to populate the PO and return a completed document for Meridian approval.
- Required fields for finance: billing entity, tax ID or VAT, billing address, PO number (if you have one), and AP contact name & email.

Ill kick off the internal purchase request as soon as we have the signed DPA and the canonical subprocessor sheet (Meridian_Subprocessors_2026-09-17.xlsx). We typically provision a test tenant within 48 hours of PO acceptance for pilot customers.

DocuSign signing URL (if you want to send via e-sign): https://www.docusign.com/en/meridian-dpa-signing
Redwood procurement portal (for PO upload): https://portal.redwood.com/procurement/submit

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: None

Alex — forwarding countersign confirmation. Per our review, the DPA is approved pending one minor redline (clarify incident notification timeline to 24 hours for critical incidents). I've attached the countersigned DPA (Meridian_DPA_signed.pdf) and a copy of the subprocessor sheet after our format normalizations (Meridian_Subprocessors_2026-09-17.xlsx). Please confirm the items below so we can close the activation loop: 

- Confirm AP contact and billing address for PO issuance.
- Confirm whether Meridian wants Redwood to generate the PO using the attached template.
- Confirm whether the subprocessor sheet is final; if so, we'll publish the list to our internal vendor registry and complete provisioning.
